# 🏴‍☠️ SAIL VR

**Rally your crew and set sail on the open seas — FREE to play 🏴‍☠️**

SAIL is an open-world multiplayer VR pirate adventure inspired by **Sea of Thieves** and **Assassin's Creed: Black Flag**. Build your crew, claim your ship, and carve your name into the ocean.

---

## ⚓ Patron Port is NOW LIVE

[media]

---

# 🏴‍☠️ What Awaits You on the Seas...

# ⚔️ Combat:
- **Ship-to-ship PvP battles** — board, blast, and plunder
- **Skeleton Raids** to repel from your vessel (PvE)
- **Epic Boss Battles** on the open water

# 💰 Adventure:
- **Treasure Hunting** across uncharted islands
- **Deep Lore** to uncover as you explore
- **Extraction Gameplay** — get in, get loot, get out alive

[media]

# 🎭 Your Crew, Your Legend:
- **Full Player & Ship Customization**
- **XP & Leveling** system
- **Instruments** to Play Sea Shanties
- **Social Lobbies** to meet and recruit fellow pirates

[media]

More content is on the way. The seas keep growing.

[media]

---

## Arrrr You Ready to Set SAIL? ⚓

[media]

---

> ⚠️ Early Access Notice: ⚠️ 
> SAIL is currently in Early Access. You may encounter bugs as we build.
> Your feedback directly shapes the game — join our community and let us know what you want to see next.
